title: Decision tree paths
statement: For a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates with available-coordinate set $A\subseteq[n]$, define its list of paths recursively: a leaf contributes the single empty path with its stored output; a query at an available coordinate contributes the paths from the zero child extended by assigning $0$ at that coordinate, followed by the paths from the one child extended by assigning $1$ there.
hypotheses_covered: Each query uses a coordinate in the available set and its children are indexed by the set with that coordinate removed
